fields.name: wf_workflow_type
fields.label: Workflow Type
fields.sourceQuote: This field is read-only. It identifies the type of workflow that you chose to edit.
fields.notes: General page (wizard page 1 of 3 inside the workflow modal - NOT a page node), row 1 of the 27-row field table. READ-ONLY. fields.name: wf_workflow_name
fields.label: Workflow Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type a new name for the workflow. This name does not have to be unique.
fields.notes: General page. Names need NOT be unique - a driver cannot use the name as a stable key. Also a column on the Workflows tab list.

fields.name: wf_require_hardcopy_receipts
fields.label: Require Hardcopy Receipts
fields.sourceQuote: Select (enable) this setting if you would like Concur Invoice to match a physical image with an invoice
fields.notes: General page. Corroborated independently by administrator-experience-8b302852.md and step-3-optional-select-enable-the-required-hardcopy-receipt-setting-c50e377e.md. Enabling it REVEALS the 'Hold for Invoice Hard Copy' step on BOTH the Steps page and the Step Rules page - see dependencyCandidates. C7 DEPTH COLLAPSE: 8b302852 places it 'on the Workflows page' while 554e86aa places it on the General page inside a workflow; no second page node was created. Image Handling (built G4) already carries a cross-reference alternate path to this field; Workflows owns it.

fields.name: wf_approval_time_expired_action
fields.label: Approval Time Expired Action
fields.sourceQuote: Defines the action to take when an approver has not approved an invoice after the maximum number of days to approve has been reached.
fields.notes: General page. Five values enumerated as bullets inside the table row. SOURCE ODDITY REPRODUCED EXACTLY: the second value is written "Send to Approver' Approver" with a stray apostrophe - do not clean it up. A daily scheduled job drives the reroute and is edited in the Import/Extract Administrator tool. LABEL CONTRADICTION with about-vendor-approval-workflow-step-and-timeout-b3d1bd2c.md, which calls the same concept 'Approval Action'. This is also the field named in unresolved endpoint dep.g1.026's source topic.

fields.name: wf_expire_after_this_many_days
fields.label: Expire After This Many Days
fields.sourceQuote: The amount of time the approver has before the invoice is rerouted based to the next action
fields.notes: General page. CONDITIONAL: 'This setting only appears if the admin has selected an option in the Approval Time Expired field.' Note the source drops the word 'Action' when referring back to the controlling field. LABEL CONTRADICTION with b3d1bd2c's 'Workflow Step Timeout Duration'.

fields.name: wf_expiration_email_to_approver
fields.label: Expiration Email to Approver
validValues: Default Payment Request Status Change Notification
fields.sourceQuote: When the time for approving an invoice has expired, the system can send out an expiration email to the approver
fields.notes: General page. A FIFTH timeout-family field the build brief did not name - present in the table, absent from the brief's list of four. Three default email template names enumerated as bullets. To customise, the source directs you to 'the Email Notification tab' (SINGULAR; the tab is 'Email Notifications' plural elsewhere - contradiction C4).

fields.name: wf_assignment_timeout_action
fields.label: Assignment Timeout Action
fields.sourceQuote: Defines the action to take when an invoice has been assigned, but the invoice owner has not submitted the invoice
fields.notes: General page. Only TWO values are enumerated. Do not complete this list by analogy with the five-value Approval Time Expired Action set.

fields.name: wf_allow_timeout_extensions_days
fields.label: Allow Timeout Extensions for This Many Days
fields.sourceQuote: The number of days that an extension will add to the current expiration date for the associated action.
fields.notes: General page. CONDITIONAL on either timeout action being enabled - see dependencyCandidates.

fields.name: wf_do_not_display_skip_steps
fields.label: Do not display the skip steps to the employee
fields.sourceQuote: If there are workflow steps that can be skipped, then the employee does not see that those steps are part of the workflow
fields.notes: General page. Both states documented: cleared, any step with a skip-step action is displayed in parentheses. Related runtime behaviour from the same table: 'If an approver cannot be resolved for a workflow step, then the step appears in parentheses to the employee.'

fields.name: wf_use_default_approver_at_or_above_level
fields.label: Use default approver at or above the current approver's level
fields.sourceQuote: Use default approver at or above the current approver's level
fields.notes: General page. Applies only if the authorized approver feature is activated, though the check is validated against regular approval steps when on. DISTINCT from 'Use default approver lookup to find authorized approver' (overview-5ce8a567.md), a separate prose-documented control this table/catalog lens does not own.

fields.name: wf_steps_can_be_added_by
fields.label: Steps Can Be Added By
fields.sourceQuote: Indicates who can add steps during the workflow process, such as the employee and/or the approver.
fields.notes: General page, and also a COLUMN on the Workflows tab list. This table row does NOT enumerate the option list; two other topics do, with DIFFERENT wording - see valueSetCandidates and contradictions. Employee disappears as an option when the Settings-tab own-approver control is cleared. The Invoice Processor can always add approvers regardless.

fields.name: wf_allow_adhoc_steps_after_final_processor
fields.label: Allow ad-hoc steps after final processor step
fields.sourceQuote: Select this option to enable the user to add additional steps to a workflow following the processor workflow process.
fields.notes: General page. Counter-intuitive UI effect worth carrying to the driver: when selected, the Add button is REMOVED from the approval step.

fields.name: wf_email_employee_when_employee_added_step_complete

fields.sourceQuote: Send an email to the employee when the step that they added has an action taken on it, such as approved.
fields.notes: General page. CONDITIONAL: 'This field is available only if you have chosen an option in the Steps Can Be Added field.'

fields.name: wf_restrict_authorized_approver_for
fields.label: Restrict Authorized Approver for
fields.sourceQuote: Defines who the employee can select when adding steps or editing selected approvers
fields.notes: General page. The 554e86aa row does NOT enumerate values; all three come from the second field table in restrict-ad-hoc-steps-to-authorized-approvers-8a523257.md. CONDITIONAL, with an SAP typo carried verbatim: 'This field is only available if you have chosen an option in the Steps Can Be Added field field.' (the word 'field' is doubled). Also gated by the Authorized Approvers > Configuration master checkbox.

fields.name: wf_restrict_approvers_limit_authority
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with limit authority for employee-added steps
fields.sourceQuote: When an employee adds a step in the workflow or edits a selected approver on the Approval Flow page within Invoice, then only display approvers marked as authorized approver based on limit of the invoice total.
fields.notes: General page. Also appears in the 8a523257 field table with the terse gloss 'Select this check box for limit-based approvers.' definition-of-amount-for-limit-approval-06806875.md refers to a SHORTER label form, 'Restrict approvers to those with limit authority check box', without the '...for employee-added steps' tail.

fields.name: wf_restrict_approvers_exception_authority
fields.label: Restrict approvers to those with exception authority for employee-added steps
fields.sourceQuote: based on exception level authority
fields.notes: General page. Also in the 8a523257 field table: 'Select this check box for exception-based approvers.' Qualification is bounded by the Minimum/Maximum Exception Level fields on Authorized Approvers > Configuration.

fields.name: wf_editable_by_groups
fields.label: Editable By Group(s)
fields.sourceQuote: Select the group rights that an administrator must have in order to modify this workflow.
fields.notes: General page. 'Global Group' is the only PRODUCT-level value the corpus enumerates; every other name in the bullets ('Global Group United States', 'Global Group Europe') is TENANT EXAMPLE DATA and is deliberately excluded. Also a Workflows-tab column, there labelled 'Editable By' with no '(s)'. Selecting Global Group makes the workflow copy-only for lower-level administrators.

fields.name: wf_allow_employee_recall_payment_requests
fields.label: Allow employee to recall payment requests
fields.sourceQuote: Select this check box to let the employee recall an invoice after it has been submitted, but prior to extraction.
fields.notes: General page. The label says 'payment requests' while its own description says 'invoice' - the same invoice/payment-request drift that afflicts the Settings tab.

fields.name: wf_skip_approval_step_if_already_approved
fields.label: Skip approval step if approver has already approved

fields.notes: General page.

fields.name: wf_cost_object_hierarchy_type
fields.label: Cost Object Hierarchy Type
fields.sourceQuote: Choose the Cost Object Workflow hierarchy type:
fields.notes: General page. fields.name: wf_submit_confirmation_agreement
fields.label: Submit Confirmation Agreement

fields.label: Approval Confirmation Agreement

fields.name: wf_email_notifications
fields.label: Email Notifications
fields.sourceQuote: The following email notifications may be selected:
fields.notes: General page. Three notification TYPES enumerated as bullets. The same three events are labelled differently in two other topics: as SLOT fields ('Approval Request Notification' / 'Status Change Notification' / 'Sent Back Notification', select-an-email-notification-in-the-workflows-tab-663bb8ac.md) and as trigger events ('Status Change' / 'Sent Back to Employee' / 'Approval Request', overview-8b3df67d.md). fields.name: wf_allow_delegated_approvers_self_approve
fields.label: Allow delegated approvers to approve their own requests
fields.sourceQuote: Enables a company to allow or prevent delegated approvers from approving invoices that they have created
fields.notes: General page. The workflow-side field ONLY; Delegate Configurations is a separate page not yet built (Workflows Run B) - do not re-home.

fields.name: wf_allow_self_approval
fields.label: Allow Self Approval
fields.sourceQuote: Allows an approver to approve their own invoices prior to submission
fields.notes: General page. Master switch for two other General-page controls - see dependencyCandidates. self-approval-for-purchase-requests-1f53fbb1.md covers the PR flavour but names no distinct label.

fields.name: wf_allow_self_cost_object_approval
fields.label: Allow Self Cost Object Approval
fields.sourceQuote: Allows the cost object approver to approve invoices regardless of whether they are the owner of the invoice or not.
fields.notes: General page. self-approval-of-cost-object-based-workflows-20fd435d.md places the same control 'In the General step' - a C6 wizard-vocabulary variant of 'the General page'.

fields.name: wf_allow_invoice_processor_process_own
fields.label: Allow Invoice Processor to Process their own Invoices
fields.sourceQuote: Allows Invoice Processors to process their own invoices
fields.notes: General page, final row of the 27-row table. Requires Allow Self Approval to be enabled.

fields.name: wf_approval_request_notification
fields.label: Approval Request Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the approver when the invoice is submitted by the employee.
fields.notes: General page (reached via Workflows (left menu) > select workflow > Modify), NOT the Email Notifications tab - homing matters and the file title ('...in the Workflows Tab') invites the wrong answer. Values are the notification objects maintained on the Email Notifications tab.

fields.name: wf_status_change_notification
fields.label: Status Change Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the submitter when the workflow status of the invoice changes.
fields.notes: General page notification slot, row 2 of 3.

fields.name: wf_sent_back_notification
fields.label: Sent Back Notification
fields.sourceQuote: This notification is sent to the submitter when the invoice is sent back to them.
fields.notes: General page notification slot, row 3 of 3. ALWAYS SENT - 'it is not configurable based on the user Profile preferences.' Delegates who submitted also receive it.

fields.name: wf_consolidate_items_single_po
fields.label: Consolidate all items on a Purchase Request for the same vendor into a single Purchase Order
fields.sourceQuote: The Consolidate all items on a Purchase Request for the same vendor into a single Purchase Order workflow setting has the following two options:
fields.notes: Reached by opening a PR workflow from the Workflows tab. A LEGITIMATELY documented two-state control - both states enumerated in the source with the default named, unlike the invented Yes values this project has already deleted. This file is also the corpus's cleanest source of the SINGULAR 'Workflow tab' (C3). SIBLING NOT EMITTED HERE: 'Allow employee to automatically transmit Purchase Orders' (allowing-automatic-transmittal-of-purchase-orders-0f2e7fae.md) is a real PR-workflow control but is documented in prose with no enumerated option list, so it falls outside this lens - the field-roster lens must carry it.

fields.name: step_step_name
fields.label: Step Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type any alphanumeric name for the workflow step.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page (wizard page 2 of 3 inside the workflow modal - NOT a page node). The name IS visible to the employee on the Approval Flow page.

fields.name: step_role
fields.label: Role
fields.sourceQuote: If it is a non-system role, such as Authorized Approver, Invoice Approver, Invoice Processor, Invoice Processor Manager, or Invoice Vendor Manager, then you must select an action or multiple actions in the Approval Actions field.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. OPEN LIST - the source hedges with 'such as', so do not treat these six as closed. A DIFFERENT role set appears in the shipped default-workflow tables including 'Employee', which is absent here - see contradictions. Selecting Authorized Approver reveals two limit/exception check boxes and, per step-1-assign-the-level-to-the-workflow-step-6035f10a.md, the Authorized Approver Level field.

fields.name: step_approver_editable_by
fields.label: Approver Editable By
fields.sourceQuote: Select who can edit the selected approver field for this step on the Approval Flow page within Invoice, the employee, approver, or both.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. The three choices are stated inline in prose rather than as a formal list - see valueSetCandidates and its confidence caveat. Employee is removed when the Settings-tab own-approver control is cleared; note this file quotes that Settings label in the SINGULAR ('...for payment request'), a third drift form beyond the two the brief named.

fields.name: step_deletable_by
fields.label: Deletable By
fields.sourceQuote: Select who can delete this step on the Approval Flow page within Invoice, the employee, approver, or both.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. Same three inline choices as Approver Editable By.

fields.name: step_initial_status
fields.label: Initial Status
fields.sourceQuote: Click an approval status that represents what the invoice status should be set to when the Step begins, such as Pending Approval.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. The selectable set = the 13 default approval statuses (default-approval-statuses-34c83d58.md, emitted as a valueSetCandidate) PLUS any custom statuses created on the Approval Statuses tab. Custom statuses drive a documented jump: the engine looks for the next step carrying that custom status as its Initial Status and skips to it, otherwise it behaves as a normal approval step.

fields.name: step_approval_actions
fields.label: Approval Actions
fields.sourceQuote: From the Approval Actions helper pane, click an action that an approver can make to an invoice that is awaiting approval.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. Populated from a helper pane, so the corpus never enumerates it - validValues empty is the correct answer here. EXPLICITLY DISTINCT from the five workflow-RULE actions; the source says so in a Note. Multi-select for approver roles, single-select when Role is System.

fields.name: step_email_employee_when_step_complete
fields.label: Email Employee when step is complete
fields.sourceQuote: Select this check box if you want to send a change of status email to the employee after this step has completed
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page. Employees can suppress delivery in Profile > Invoice Preferences; content can be localised.

fields.name: step_can_exit_with_blocking_exceptions
fields.label: Can exit step with blocking exceptions
fields.sourceQuote: Toggle (disable) this check box to block the invoice from progressing past approval in workflow.
fields.notes: Add Workflow Step page, final row of 8. The source says 'Toggle (disable)' - the control is described ONLY in its disabling direction; the enabled semantics are not stated and must not be inferred.

fields.name: step_step_order
fields.label: Step Order
fields.sourceQuote: To place the steps in the proper workflow order, use the Step Order column.
fields.notes: A COLUMN on the Steps page used to reorder steps. HARD CONSTRAINTS the driver must honour: 'You cannot reorder some of the steps.' (fab249d1) versus 'You cannot reorder all steps.' (edit-and-reorder-workflow-steps-41535156.md) - two phrasings of one restriction; 'The Vendor Approval system step cannot precede the Cost Object Approval step.' (step-3-edit-the-workflow-steps-f2731590.md, echoed in default-workflows-a6fa157a.md); and 'By default, the new workflow step appears in the workflow just prior to the Prepayment Validation step.'

fields.name: rule_name
fields.label: Name
fields.sourceQuote: Type any alphanumeric name for the workflow rule. The name does not have to be unique.
fields.notes: Edit Condition window on the Step Rules page (wizard page 3 of 3). Names need not be unique. Not all steps can carry rules: 'If the selected step can have a rule, the New button becomes available.'

fields.name: rule_force_evaluation
fields.label: Force Evaluation
fields.sourceQuote: If the check box is _not_ selected, then the rule is evaluated and executed only if all other rules in this step were determined to be false.
fields.notes: Edit Condition window. Both states documented at length with a worked two-rule example.

fields.name: rule_action_name
fields.label: Action Name
fields.sourceQuote: The Edit Action window appears. From the Action Name list, select the desired action.
fields.notes: Edit Action window on the Step Rules page. FIVE actions, enumerated as the rows of the second field table. CARDINALITY RULES from the same file: a single rule may hold only ONE of {Skip step, Change approver, Send back to employee} but MULTIPLE of {Generate an exception, Send email}; conflicting actions raise an error. SEQUENCING for the automation: 'workflow rules execute at the beginning of the Step before any human interaction'. RETURN PATH: 'When done with all rules and actions, click Done on the Workflows tab.' - the wizard returns you to the tab, confirming it is a modal sequence and not navigation.

fields.name: cond_left_parenthesis
fields.label: A: Left Parenthesis
fields.sourceQuote: A: Left Parenthesis
fields.notes: Condition page inside the Workflows tool - the WORKFLOWS side of the shared condition editor. DEDUPE IS ON FILES, NOT FIELD NAMES: the Audit Rules side is the-condition-page-5d4ea870.md (already mined for the built Audit Rules page); this file is cited by zero graph fields. Do NOT dedupe against the built Audit Rules 91-field roster, which is itself internally duplicated ~8 times. Range: zero to three - see compressedRanges.

fields.name: cond_data_object_b
fields.label: B: Data Object
fields.sourceQuote: The choices that appear in this list are based on the event that triggers the rule:
fields.notes: Condition page, left-hand data object. SEVEN values enumerated as bullets. PROVISIONING CAVEAT stated by the source itself - the choices vary with the triggering event - so a tenant may legitimately show fewer.

fields.name: cond_field_value_c
fields.label: C: Field/Value
fields.sourceQuote: Select an item from the helper pane that appears. The information that appears in this pane is based upon the selection made in the Data Object list.
fields.notes: Condition page. Contents depend on the B: Data Object selection; Table 2 is EXPLICITLY a partial list - see valueSetCandidates. BRIEF LABEL CORRECTION: the recon wrote 'C: Field-Value'; the file writes 'C: Field/Value' with a slash.

fields.name: cond_operator_d
fields.label: D: Operator
fields.sourceQuote: Select an item from the helper pane that appears. The information that appears in this pane is based upon previous choices.
fields.notes: Condition page. The corpus never enumerates the operator list; it only says the list changes with the data type ('equals, not equals, is greater than, and so on'). Empty validValues is the correct answer, not a gap.

fields.name: cond_data_object_e
fields.label: E: Data Object
fields.sourceQuote: The system provides the option that best suits the previous choices. Change it if necessary.
fields.notes: Condition page, right-hand data object. System-defaulted but overridable. If the condition uses a second field its data type must match the first.

fields.name: cond_field_value_f
fields.label: F: Field/Value
fields.sourceQuote: For specific field/value choices, refer to Table 2 for more information.
fields.notes: Condition page, right-hand field/value. Its helper-pane sentence is byte-identical to column C's, so the disambiguating Note is quoted instead. The value's data type must match the field's.

fields.name: cond_right_parenthesis
fields.label: G: Right Parenthesis
fields.sourceQuote: G: Right Parenthesis
fields.notes: Condition page. Left and right parenthesis counts must match, and 'You can use up to three parentheses for both left and right sides.'

fields.name: cond_and_or
fields.label: H: And/Or
fields.sourceQuote: Select either option to join the current condition to the next condition
fields.notes: Condition page. A real DOM-shape constraint for the driver: the row appears only BETWEEN conditions, 'never after the final condition'. Evaluation is strictly left to right with no precedence of and over or.

fields.name: list_workflows_columns
fields.label: Workflows tab list columns
fields.sourceQuote: The following information appears.
fields.notes: The four COLUMNS of the workflow grid on the Workflows tab - what a driver reads to locate a workflow row before clicking Modify, Copy or Remove. Emitted as ONE record rather than four fields because these are read-only display columns whose editable twins already exist as wf_workflow_name / wf_workflow_type / wf_steps_can_be_added_by / wf_editable_by_groups; four separate fields would have duplicated those names on this page. fields.name: status_inv_status
fields.label: Status
fields.sourceQuote: Type a name for the new status.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses tab > Invoice sub-tab, Request Status window. FOUR fields on this sub-tab, not the three the inventory estimated.

fields.name: status_inv_action_text
fields.label: Action Text
fields.sourceQuote: Type descriptive text to be used as the action text. This text becomes button text for the approver. When the approver clicks the button, the invoice approval status changes to this approval status.

fields.name: status_inv_description
fields.label: Description
fields.sourceQuote: Type the description text.
fields.notes: Approval Statuses > Invoice.

fields.name: status_inv_editable_by_groups
fields.label: Editable By Group(s)

contradictions.topic: The exception-level input range is 'one to 99' on the Workflows Settings tab and '0 and 99' on the built Exceptions page

If the automation ever needs to block on level 0 it should expect the Workflows field to reject it, and should surface that rather than silently coercing.
contradictions.notes: Hypothesis: an exception can carry level 0 (non-urgent, per the Exceptions text) but a threshold of 0 would block every submission, so SAP starts the threshold at 1. Plausible, but the corpus never states the reasoning and the two pages are simply inconsistent as written.

contradictions.topic: The Default PO Payment Workflow is documented with two steps in one guide and seven in another
